specPlan.text:
SCREENS & BEHAVIOUR · PLANNING
PLAN (Workouts tab)
• − / + sets how many days are in the split (1–14). Adding creates an empty "Day N"; removing drops the last day.
• Day card: body parts, counts, Edit, Start workout. Start is hidden until the day has at least one exercise.

EDIT DAY
• Warm-up list at the top, Cool-down list at the bottom. Item = exercise name + optional video link (no time or reps). All inline-editable.
• Body parts → exercises → sets. Every set has its own weight and reps. "Add set" copies the previous set.
• Each exercise has an optional video link field; the dark play button opens the link in a new tab.
• Add exercise form: name, starting sets / reps / weight (copied into every set), optional link.

HISTORY
• Newest first. Card: date, day, body parts, time, duration, volume (sum of weight × reps), sets done, lifts up. Tap to expand per-exercise sets plus warm-up / cool-down counts.
• Empty state when nothing is logged.

specSession.text:
SCREENS & BEHAVIOUR · WORKOUT SESSION
• Three phases in order: Warm-up → Workout → Cool-down. A phase with no items shows "None today" and is skipped (2.8).
• Phase bar at the top: each phase shows its own done / total and mini progress bar; the current one is outlined. Tap a phase to jump to it.
• Below it: "Step N of M", the phase title, the phase's own progress bar and a hint.
• Warm-up / Cool-down rows: tap the check → row fades and strikes through; tap again → back to normal.
• Workout: one card per exercise, one row per set. Check fades + strikes the set; tap again to undo. − / + change weight and reps and save to the plan immediately. Weight + / − moves by 0.1 kg per tap (60.0 → 60.1), reps by 1. An exercise leaves the list once all its sets are checked.
• "Last time" line and green "up" tag compare against Set.last.
• Current phase finished → dark card "Start <next phase>" (2.2, 2.4).
• Every phase finished → the workout is saved to history automatically the moment the last item is checked (no save button): write a Session and copy each done set's weight / reps into Set.last. Then show Workout complete (2.6) with each phase's count, a "Saved to history automatically" line, and View in history / Done (back to Workouts).
• Quit → bottom sheet (2.7): Save & quit (only when something is done), Discard workout, Keep going.
• Undo un-checks the most recent check.

oceanPalette.text:
OCEAN PALETTE · how it's used
• Fresh sky #00A6FB: accent (Start buttons, progress fill, active tab, check marks, 'up' tags, day count). Text on it is Ink black.
• Deep space blue #003554: dark surfaces (workout header, day badges, phase-done card, primary buttons).
• Ink black #051923: main text.
• Baltic blue #006494: 'went up' numbers on the set steppers.
• Steel blue #0582CA: offered as an alternate accent in Tweaks.
• Neutrals tinted from the palette: background #EAF3F9, borders #D5E3EC, secondary text #3D5A6C.
Same screens and behaviour as the Lime page; only colours change.

goldPalette.text:
GOLD & GUNMETAL PALETTE · how it's used
• Old gold #E2C044: accent (Start buttons, progress fill, active tab, check marks, 'up' tags, day count). Text on it is Carbon black.

switchSettings.text:
SETTINGS & PALETTES
• Gear button (top right of Workouts and History) opens Settings; Back returns to the screen you came from.
• Colour palette: Lime, Ocean blue, Gold & gunmetal, Rosewood & aqua. Tapping one applies it to every screen immediately and is remembered.
• Weight unit: kg / lb segmented control. The + / − step stays 0.1 either way.
• Build colours as theme tokens (ink, dark, badge, ground, muted, line, border, accent, up…) and swap the whole token set per palette; never hard-code a colour in a screen.
• Every artboard on this page is the same live app: open Settings in any of them and switch palettes.

EXPORT / IMPORT (CSV)
• Export CSV: builds one CSV with the whole plan and history, then opens the Android share sheet. Shows a confirmation banner (7).
• Import CSV: opens the file picker (.csv only), parses and validates the file, then shows a sheet with the file name and what was found (8). 'Replace with this file' swaps in the new plan and history; Cancel changes nothing.
• Success banner (9). On a bad file, show which row / column is wrong, change nothing, and open the CSV format help (10).
• CSV rows (first column = row type): day · routine · set · session · session_set. Weights in kg.
